privacypolicy_esta_politica_de_privacida: This Privacy Policy describes, on a preliminary basis, how SafeRent plans to collect, use and protect information about people using the platform. This content is a working draft of the project and is subject to review before final publication.
privacypolicy_podemos_recopilar_la_infor: We may collect information you provide directly when creating an account, listing a property or communicating with other users, such as your name, email address, phone number and details of the property you list.
privacypolicy_la_informacion_recopilada_: The information collected is used to operate the platform: display properties, facilitate communication between landlords and tenants, and improve the overall service experience.
privacypolicy_tu_perfil_puede_incluir_da: Your profile may include basic identification and contact information. We aim to make only the necessary information visible to other platform users.
privacypolicy_las_publicaciones_de_propi: Property listings may include an approximate address, photographs, price, available amenities and reviews from other users to provide more complete information to people looking to rent.
privacypolicy_la_mensajeria_interna_busc: Internal messaging aims to allow landlords and tenants to contact each other without exposing personal information from the outset. Conversation content is retained while the account remains active.
privacypolicy_7_uso_de_tecnologias_neces: 7. Technologies necessary for the service to function
privacypolicy_saferent_utiliza_tecnologi: SafeRent uses basic browser storage technologies solely for essential platform functions, such as keeping you signed in.
privacypolicy_no_vendemos_la_informacion: We do not sell our users' information. Contact information is shared only between parties involved in a conversation or rental request, where appropriate.
privacypolicy_trabajamos_en_implementar_: We are working to implement reasonable measures to protect stored information. No system is completely infallible, and we continue to improve these practices as the platform evolves.
privacypolicy_conservamos_la_informacion: We retain information while the account is active or it is needed to provide the service, and aim to delete or anonymize it when it no longer serves a purpose.
privacypolicy_como_usuario_podras_solici: As a user, you may request access to, updates to or deletion of your personal information through the contact channels SafeRent makes available for this purpose.
privacypolicy_esta_politica_podra_actual: This policy may be updated as the project evolves. We will seek to communicate significant changes within the platform where appropriate.
privacypolicy_si_tienes_dudas_sobre_esta: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, you can write to us through the contact channels available in the Support section.
termsofservice_al_utilizar_saferent_acep: By using SafeRent you accept these Terms of Service. This content is a working draft of the project and may be updated as the platform evolves.
termsofservice_saferent_es_una_plataform: SafeRent is a technology platform that connects people looking to rent a home with people or organizations offering rental properties and facilitates their interaction. SafeRent does not own, let or manage the listed properties.
termsofservice_para_acceder_a_ciertas_fu: Certain features require an account with truthful information. You are responsible for keeping your sign-in credentials confidential.
termsofservice_la_plataforma_contempla_d: The platform provides different roles, including tenant, landlord and administrator, each with defined functions and permissions within the system.
termsofservice_los_arrendatarios_pueden_: Landlords can list properties with information such as photographs, price, amenities and conditions. Published information must be accurate and correspond to the actual property.
termsofservice_quien_publica_una_propied: Anyone listing a property is responsible for the accuracy of the information shared and for keeping the availability of their listings up to date.
termsofservice_quien_busca_una_vivienda_: Anyone looking for housing is responsible for using information available on the platform reasonably and communicating with landlords in good faith.
termsofservice_saferent_facilita_un_cana: SafeRent provides an internal messaging channel for users to communicate. Use of this channel must respect appropriate conduct between the parties.
termsofservice_las_resenas_buscan_reflej: Reviews aim to reflect real user experiences. SafeRent may review reported content that is offensive, false or in breach of these terms.
termsofservice_no_esta_permitido_publica: Publishing false information, using the platform for fraudulent purposes, or sharing offensive or discriminatory content or content that infringes third-party rights is prohibited.
termsofservice_los_usuarios_pueden_repor: Users can report listings or behavior they consider inappropriate. The SafeRent team may review these reports according to its internal procedures.
termsofservice_saferent_podra_suspender_: SafeRent may suspend or delete accounts that breach these terms, prioritizing safety and trust within the community.
termsofservice_saferent_actua_como_inter: SafeRent acts as a technology intermediary and does not guarantee availability, absolute accuracy or the outcome of rental processes carried out between users.
termsofservice_el_nombre_la_marca_y_los_: The SafeRent name, brand and visual elements belong to the project. Content posted by users remains their responsibility.
termsofservice_estos_terminos_podran_act: These terms may be updated as the project evolves. We will seek to communicate significant changes within the platform.
termsofservice_para_consultas_relacionad: For questions about these Terms of Service, you can contact us through the channels available in the Support section.
privacypolicypage_como_saferent_recopila: How SafeRent collects, uses and protects its users' information.
